setup.effects: Build, migrate canonical local state, save private settings, claim first owner and request development mail, then stop.

dev.effects: Foreground local Vite development runtime; guarded outbox only.

preview.effects: Foreground fixed local production Worker and assets; guarded outbox only.

build.effects: Build actual Worker/assets while excluding and restoring private settings.

verify.effects: Run complete product verification and public CLI journey.

reset.effects: Confirmed removal of inventoried local data and settings; preserves source, exports and deployment receipts.

deploy.effects: Owner-account Base deploy-kit deployment and health; dry run only builds and validates locally without provider calls.

export.effects: Export complete local Dial data through the reviewed portability policy. Remote unsupported.

import.effects: Validate and restore complete local archive into an empty destination after explicit confirmation. Remote unsupported.

release.effects: Base release producer and receipts; never pushes or deploys.

outbox.effects: Show guarded local outbox URL; explicit owner email requests ordinary local sign-in.

doctor.effects: Read-only tool and local configuration diagnostics.

environmentSources.ENVIRONMENT: Choose the target mode; the development outbox requires the development mode.
environmentSources.APP_URL: Use the public origin recorded by deployment setup, or the canonical loopback origin for the development outbox.
environmentSources.SESSION_SECRET: Generate a fresh session secret and supply it to the deploy step.
environmentSources.MAIL_PROVIDER: Choose SendGrid or Resend explicitly, or development for the guarded local outbox; absence selects legacy Resend.
environmentSources.MAIL_API_KEY: Supply the selected hosted provider credential privately as the native mail API key.
environmentSources.MAIL_FROM: Use a verified noreply or no-reply sender for hosted mail, or the local setup sender for the development outbox.
environmentSources.RESEND_API_KEY: Supply the legacy Resend credential privately when the provider selector is absent.
environmentSources.RESEND_FROM_EMAIL: Use a verified noreply or no-reply sender for legacy Resend when the provider selector is absent.

environmentInspection: RER check validates source declarations. RER doctor checks process-environment configuration and required loops, private local settings, state safety and installed tools. Neither contacts providers or proves delivery.
